metadata.question: Were the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels higher over Shanghai than over Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) levels between Shanghai and Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020. 1. Data Collection: I need to use satellite data that measures tropospheric NO₂. The best source for this is the TROPOMI instrument on Sentinel-5P, which has a 'NO2' band for tropospheric nitrogen dioxide. 2. Locations: - Shanghai: approximately 31.2°N, 121.5°E - Wuhan: approximately 30.6°N, 114.3°E 3. Time period: April 20 - May 12, 2020 4. Processing: - Get TROPOMI NO₂ data for both cities - Calculate mean NO₂ values for each city - Compare Shanghai vs Wuhan 5. Potential issues: - Cloud cover might affect data quality - Need to check if collections are empty - Need to validate pixel counts I'll use points for both cities and calculate mean NO₂ values, then compare them. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.5, 31.2]); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3, 30.6]); const startDate = '2020-04-20'; const endDate = '2020-05-12'; // 2. Data Acquisition - TROPOMI NO2 data const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = no2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total NO2 images in period: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No NO2 data available for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for Shanghai const shanghaiMean = no2Collection.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Calculate mean NO2 for Wuhan const wuhanMean = no2Collection.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Get pixel counts to validate data const shanghaiCount = no2Collection.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const wuhanCount = no2Collection.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const shanghaiVal = shanghaiMean.getInfo(); const wuhanVal = wuhanMean.getInfo(); const shanghaiPixels = shanghaiCount.getInfo(); const wuhanPixels = wuhanCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Shanghai NO2: ${shanghaiVal ? shanghaiVal.toFixed(6) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${shanghaiPixels}`); console.log(`Wuhan NO2: ${wuhanVal ? wuhanVal.toFixed(6) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${wuhanPixels}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (shanghaiVal === null || wuhanVal === null || isNaN(shanghaiVal) || isNaN(wuhanVal) || shanghaiPixels === 0 || wuhanPixels === 0) { if (shanghaiPixels === 0 || wuhanPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both locations."); console.log("C2"); } else { console.log("Calculation resulted in invalid values."); console.log("C3"); } } else if (shanghaiVal > wuhanVal) { console.log("Shanghai NO2 higher than Wuhan."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Shanghai NO2 not higher than Wuhan."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
